about: Citations for the tools and databases the pipelines run, keyed by the id a methods text cites them as ([@id]) and config/databases.json lists them under. An author is "Family, Initials", or an organisation as written; et_al marks a list cut short. publish_dashboard.sh derives the author-year citation, the formatted reference and the BibTeX entry from these fields; cite overrides the citation where the authors cannot give it. See docs/operations/databases.md.
